 Nintendo covers eShop highlights for October 2026 in a new video 
 What a month it was!
 04 November 2026 
 by rawmeatcowboy 
 0
 Somehow, October 2026 has come and gone, and we’re well into November! October went by so quickly it’s enough to make your head spin, and there’s no doubt you missed a few of the great releases that came to Switch and Switch 2. Thankfully, Nintendo is here to remind you of what’s now available!
 You want games? You’ve got games! Take a look at some of the highlights from October in the video above. As you’ll quickly see, it’s a very exciting time to be a Nintendo fan!
 As always, there are plenty of other games that came to Switch and Switch 2 in October. This is just meant to be a look at some of the bigger-name games, but do yourself a favor and dive into the eShop to dig up some of last month’s hidden gems!
